title: Exercise After a BBL: When to Walk, Lift and Train Glutes
meta_description: Walk from day 1 or 2, nothing strenuous for about a month, normal exercise at about 8 weeks once your surgeon clears you. What comes back when.
excerpt: Walk from day 1 or 2, avoid anything strenuous for about the first month, and return to normal exercise at about 8 weeks once your surgeon clears you. What comes back when, why seats wait, when squats return, and what no source can tell you yet.
quick_answer:
When can I exercise after a BBL?

The Aesthetic Society says you should be able to walk after the second day and can return to normal exercise after 8 weeks. Cleveland Clinic says to avoid heavy lifting and strenuous activity for one month, and an ASPS article allows light activity like fast walking after that.
